items.name: Big clock
items.author: Lumen
items.description: A large clock with the date under it.

items.name: Dice
items.author: Lumen
items.description: Click to roll. A small example of a widget with a script; the script asks for no permissions.

items.name: Day progress
items.author: Lumen
items.description: How much of today has gone, as a bar. Its script asks for no permissions.

items.name: Minimal time
items.author: Lumen
items.description: Just the time, as large as the widget. Resize the widget and the time follows.

items.name: Stacked clock
items.author: Lumen
items.description: The hour over the minutes, with the day and date beside them.

items.name: Date tile
items.author: Lumen
items.description: Today as a tile: the day of the week, a big number, the month.

items.name: System dials
items.author: Lumen
items.description: Processor, memory and graphics as three dials.

items.name: System blocks
items.author: Lumen
items.description: Processor, memory, graphics and disk as rows of blocks.

items.name: Media controls
items.author: Lumen
items.description: What is playing, with buttons to go back, play or pause, and skip.

items.name: Weather now
items.author: Lumen
items.description: The weather now, large. Colour or plain pictures, as set under Weather.

items.name: Forecast strip
items.author: Lumen
items.description: The next three days side by side.

items.name: Disk and uptime
items.author: Lumen
items.description: How full the system drive is, and how long the PC has been on.

items.name: Greeting
items.author: Lumen
items.description: Good morning, afternoon or evening in a handwritten hand. Its script asks for no permissions.

items.name: Home Assistant by script
items.author: Lumen
items.description: An example for people writing scripts: a Home Assistant switch made with a script and your own token. For everyday use, connect Home Assistant under Settings instead; it needs no script.

items.name: Ledger
items.author: Lumen
items.description: A solid card with a firm outline and nearly square corners.
